## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `82d9d267e895a74f2206d827b9e91038ba2cfb2a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml + ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs, ui/scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts, ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/root-ci.ts, ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts, ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs, ui/scripts/test-shard-sequencer.mjs, ui/scripts/test-shard-partition.mjs, ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json, ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs, ui/vitest.config.mts, ui/package.json, ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs, .github/workflows/shard-timings-refresh.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml (schedule-gate), scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs, scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs, scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs, scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs

Inputs read: card #29517 body and all four comments (triage 6583780380, claim 6583993194, surface note 6585439229, os-dev-report 6587495139), PR #29588 body, file list and net diff (5 files, 511+/40-, against merge-base dbca3ef0), the check-runs on 82d9d267 (refreshed read-only: 56 completed, every completed one `success` or an expected `skipped`; `Lint UI`, `Test Core (1/8)` and `Type Check · consumer gates` still in progress at the time of this record). Ruling 6583487846 on #29469 Q2 A governs: a reporter and a dataset only, no new failing check, no threshold. The two hits files were judged against the tree at `pr-29588`, never the PR body's account.

### ① Derived judgments

- ci.yml `test-ui`, whole-suite leg (`MODE=full`: push, schedule, workflow_dispatch, and a pull request or queue build that failed open) now passes a third reporter, `ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs`, beside `default` and `github-actions`; the affected speed passes none. Right: a slice is not a measurement, and the selector only ever reads push/schedule runs.
- New step `Publish this shard's per-file test timings`: `always()` AND the THE TWO SPEEDS deny-list, `continue-on-error: true`, `if-no-files-found: warn`, retention 7 (schedule) / 2 (else). Right: it can never red a shard; a cancelled or failed shard's partial upload is rejected by the selector because `judgeRun` demands every `Test UI (N/16)` job concluded `success` and every artifact present and unexpired. `check-expected-skips` and the dispatch-gates self-test both read the deny-list spelling and are green on this head.
- `Test UI (N/16)` job name, the `Test UI` required context (`test-ui-gate`, `name:`, `if: always()`), its `OS_AGGREGATOR_MEMBERS` / `OS_AGGREGATOR_NON_MEMBERS` roster and the 16-wide matrix are byte-unchanged; the ci.yml diff is confined to the `test-ui` job's run step, one new step and the comment above them. Right.
- New workflow `UI Test Timings Refresh`: Mondays 05:47 UTC, `workflow_dispatch`, `pull_request` filtered to its own file and the three scripts it loads. It publishes one check-run context, `Regenerate the per-file test timings`, that appears only on PRs editing those four paths and reds only on the refresh's own breakage (select exit other than 0/3, every download dropped, push/PR failure). Right under the ruling: nothing grades a duration and no threshold exists anywhere in the lane; the context is the same optional one `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` already lists, and the shape is `shard-timings-refresh.yml`'s (which `dispatch-gates.mjs` requires: a lane reachable only on a schedule is refused).
- The refresh declares `dispatch-gates: no-check-families` on line 64, a whole one-line reason followed by a blank line; the self-test census names it as the tenth row (`:64`, sorted position correct). `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` is green. Right.
- `shardJobName` now spells `Test UI (N/M)` (was objectui's `Test (shard N/M)`, which no job here carries, so `select` could never have taken a run); `generated_by` names the workflow that exists. Private ui script exports, consumers are the selector and its test. Right.
- The committed `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` keeps the stale `generated_by` and `measured.at` 2026-10-19: generator output, rewritten by the first refresh PR, which is what closes the card's Done-when. Right, and the PR body says so.
- Accept-set outside hits: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` census 9 to 10 (surface note 6585439229, accepted by the seat; lane ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT). Read, not reviewed.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` label present. The diff publishes nothing: two workflow files, a private ui script and its test, a pm self-test census row. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body matches the claim (6583993194) and the diff; no `(narrowing)` arm and no published spec or schema surface is touched. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Deviation 1 (reporter spelled `"${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs"`, not `./scripts/...`): answered. `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs`'s `INVOCATION_RE` strips a leading `./` and keys `scripts/...` to the ROOT `scripts/`, so the relative spelling mints a path with no file behind it. The absolute spelling is read by neither that regex nor the invocation guard (a `--flag=value` token is self-delimiting there). The test pins the exact spelling in argv.
- Deviation 2 (PR body footer form): cosmetic, no bearing.
- `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`: see ④ for the reviewer's own security reading; nothing to escalate.
- Out-of-scope note (dependabot-merge-gate.mjs OPTIONAL_CONTEXTS row describes objectui's workflow): legacy prose, the context name matches, left alone. Agreed.
- Surface widening (dispatch-gates self-test row): seat-accepted, the census comment assigns the row to the declaring author. Agreed.

### ④ Design judgment

**ci.yml** (`test-ui`): holds against the code it cites.
- The reporter writes `$OBJECTUI_TEST_TIMINGS_OUT` from `onTestRunEnd`, catches every error into one stderr line, and reads `config.root` (ui/, since `pnpm --dir ui run test` sets cwd) so report paths are relative to the vitest root, the same root `test-shard-sequencer.mjs` uses for `pathKey`. Keys will match the sequencer's.
- Upload gating: the deny-list is the file's own full-battery spelling; `workflow_dispatch` runs also upload but the selector takes only push/schedule, harmless. `filter` sets `ui: 'true'` on schedule (paths-filter skipped, `|| 'true'`), so every 4-hourly run runs all 16 shards in `mode=full`; `lint.yml`'s schedule-gate is that workflow's and does not touch ci.yml. The 7-day retention therefore comfortably covers a quiet weekend. Push runs only run Test UI when the diff touches ui or a ui-consumed package; others are skipped by name.
- Nothing here or in the refresh grades a duration or adds a threshold; the only new red surface on ci.yml is none (`continue-on-error` and `warn`).
- should-fix (A): no runner-side evidence on this head that vitest loads the reporter by absolute path. This PR's own Test UI shards ran the affected speed (`select-affected-tests.mjs`: workflows and `scripts/` reach tests only through the always-on set), and `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` records argv through a stand-in `pnpm`, so the sixteen green `Test UI (N/16)` prove the step's shell, not the reporter load. A reporter that fails to LOAD reds the vitest run at the load boundary, unlike one that fails to write; the first proof is the first push or scheduled run on main (failure direction: an immediately visible main-red, revert is the PR). Recommend a `workflow_dispatch` of ci.yml right after merge, watched, or a vitest-spawning smoke in `test-file-timings.test.ts` that passes the exact spelling against one file.
- should-fix (B): the upload carries no `overwrite: true` (ci.yml's own shard-attestation uploads do). On a re-run of a failed shard, the second attempt's upload of the same name errors, `continue-on-error` absorbs it, and the selector (jobs `filter=latest`, artifacts by name) merges the FIRST attempt's report of that shard. Per-file medians make the harm small, but `overwrite: true` is the one-line fix.
- should-fix (C, prose): the step comment's window arithmetic ("newest fifty completed runs ... so a push run's report needs two days and a scheduled run's a week") mislabels the bound: with main merges every 9-16 minutes (this file's own concurrency note) the newest fifty completed main runs span hours on a weekday and the selector examines at most 30 push/schedule candidates; retention is over-provisioned, which is the safe direction, but the next reader should not derive the window from retention.

**ui-test-timings-refresh.yml**: holds against the precedent and the ruling.
- Token scope and secret use: top-level `contents: read`; the job adds `actions: read`; `persist-credentials: false`. The App token is minted only when `changed == 'true' AND event != pull_request`, narrowed by `owner` + `repositories` (this repo by name; an empty list would widen to the installation) to `contents: write` + `pull-requests: write`, lives only in the write step's `env:` as `GH_TOKEN`, and is revoked by the action's post step. No `workflows` grant; the branch is cut from the checked-out ref and adds one commit touching only the dataset. Same pair and action as `fleet-write.yml` and `shard-timings-refresh.yml`.
- Can a pull_request reach the write path: no. `pull_request` never reaches the credential or mint steps; its write step runs with `DRY_RUN=true` and `GH_TOKEN=github.token` (read-only), every network act (`gh auth setup-git`, `git push`, `gh pr create`, `gh pr view`, both label calls) is behind `outward`, and the script refuses any `DRY_RUN` spelling other than true/false and refuses `false` on a pull_request. No `pull_request_target`.
- Untrusted input to shells: no `${{ }}` inside any `run:`; all GitHub-context values enter through `env:`. Run ids are numeric from the Actions API (listing filtered to `branch=main`, `event` push/schedule, `status=completed`), split by whitespace only. Artifact contents come from main's own ci.yml runs (uploads are off on pull_request and merge_group), are parsed by `readRunReports` (schema-tagged) and validated by `datasetWeights`; report file names reach only `summary.md` and the PR body via `--body-file` (no shell) and the selector's stderr reaches the step summary sed-escaped. `gh run download --pattern 'test-file-timings-*'` places each artifact in its own subdirectory under a per-run directory.
- NOT MEASURED and partial data: select exit 3 writes `not_measured=true`, a warning and a summary, exits 0; download, generate, compose, credential, mint, write and nothing-changed steps all skip (their `if:` chains read empty outputs). A run whose download fails or returns other than 16 reports is dropped by name and `kept-runs.json` is rewritten to the kept set, so `measured.runs` describes exactly what was merged; zero kept is a red, correctly a finding. The `Regenerate the per-file test timings` check-run on this head is green on exactly the NOT MEASURED path (no main run has uploaded reports yet), which also proves the script's import closure resolves without a `pnpm install` (node builtins and sibling scripts only).
- Opens a PR, never pushes main: `git switch -c claude/ui-test-timings-refresh-$NEWEST`, `gh pr create --base main`, additive `skip-changeset` POST with a read-back and one re-apply, the precedent's shape line for line.
- Reporter can never red a shard: see ci.yml above; the refresh's own red is only its own breakage, as its header states.
- `UI_TEST_SHARDS: '16'` is pinned to `shardTotal(ci, 'test-ui')` by the test; the download pattern is pinned to `artifactName`.
- should-fix (D, inherited from the precedent): no guard that `workflow_dispatch` runs on `refs/heads/main`. A dispatch on another branch cuts the bot branch from that ref, so the opened PR would carry that branch's commits under the fleet identity against `main`. Operator-only (dispatch needs write), the selector still reads main's runs, and the precedent has the same hole; a one-line `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` conjunct on the credential/mint/write steps (or an early refusal) closes it in both lanes.
- Observation, no action: unlike the precedent there is no self-test step before the generator is trusted; the scripts carry no `--self-test` and are pinned instead by Test UI's `test-file-timings.test.ts` (15 cases, run on any change to them via the always-on set), which the `no-check-families` reason states.

Security-relevant observation, stated plainly: the write path is reachable on `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` only; a `pull_request` run of this lane cannot mint or use the fleet App credential and cannot push, open or label; the credential is narrowed to this repository and two write permissions and never reaches a script argument or the log; no external string reaches a shell unquoted.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: A (runner proof of the reporter load), B (`overwrite: true` on the upload), C (window prose), D (main-ref guard on dispatch, inherited).

Second record on this PR; the first (6587756255, on 82d9d267) returned PASS with four should-fixes. This head is 82d9d267 plus one commit (3 files, 60+/4-) taking all four. The whole PR is judged here on 5f0c784f, carrying forward what still holds; the delta was read as `git diff 82d9d267 pr-29588c`, the tree as `pr-29588c`. Inputs: card #29517 body and comments (card-comments2.json: no comment since the os-dev-report 6587495139), PR body (byte-identical to the one reviewed on 82d9d267), file list, the net diff against merge-base (5 files, 567+/40-), and the check-runs on 5f0c784f (checks2.json: 58 check-runs, all completed, 50 `success`, 8 expected `skipped`; none in progress). Ruling 6583487846 on #29469 Q2 A governs: a reporter and a dataset only, no new failing check, no threshold.

### ① Derived judgments

Carried forward unchanged from 6587756255, re-read on this tree, all still right:
- ci.yml `test-ui` whole-suite leg passes the third reporter; the affected speed passes none.
- The upload step is `always()` AND the THE TWO SPEEDS deny-list, `continue-on-error: true`, `if-no-files-found: warn`, retention 7/2; now also `overwrite: true` (the shard-attestation uploads' setting), so a re-run shard replaces its report instead of leaving the first attempt's under a `continue-on-error` warning. Right: still cannot red a shard; `check-expected-skips` and the dispatch-gates self-test are green on this head.
- `Test UI (N/16)`, the `Test UI` required context, its roster env and the 16-wide matrix are byte-unchanged; the ci.yml diff is confined to the `test-ui` job.
- The new workflow's one context `Regenerate the per-file test timings` is optional, appears only on PRs editing its four paths and reds only on its own breakage. Right under the ruling.
- `dispatch-gates: no-check-families` is still on line 64 (the delta inserts after line 101), whole, blank line after; census row ten; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` green.
- `shardJobName` spells `Test UI (N/M)`; `generated_by` names the live workflow; the committed dataset stays generator output until the first refresh PR.
- New this head: a `workflow_dispatch` on any ref but `refs/heads/main` is refused before anything runs. Right: narrows the accept set of the write path to main only; `schedule` and `pull_request` skip the step.
- New this head: `test-file-timings.test.ts` gains one case that spawns the real vitest CLI with `--reporter=ABSOLUTE_PATH` in a scratch root. Right: it is a unit test in Test UI's always-on set, not a check family, and grades no duration.
- Outside hits (unchanged): `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` census row, seat-accepted at TIER_DEFAULT.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` label present, the diff publishes nothing, `Clause-②: no` matches claim 6583993194 and the diff. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The four should-fixes of 6587756255: A (runner proof of the reporter load), B (`overwrite: true`), C (window prose), D (main-ref guard) are each taken in this head and judged below. D was asked of both lanes; core's `shard-timings-refresh.yml` is deliberately untouched here and the seat cards it separately. Agreed: outside this card's surface.
- Surface widening and the dependabot-merge-gate prose note: unchanged, agreed.

### ④ Design judgment

**ci.yml** (`test-ui`): holds.
- Everything judged on 82d9d267 still reads the same in this tree: the reporter never throws into vitest, writes under `config.root` (ui/), and the selector rejects any run with a non-`success` shard or a missing/expired artifact.
- B taken: `overwrite: true` on the upload. With it, a re-run of a shard replaces that shard's artifact, so the selector's `filter=latest` jobs and the artifacts it merges describe the same attempt. The test's upload pins (`uses`, `path`, `name`, `continue-on-error`, `if-no-files-found`, the two deny-list conjuncts) are unaffected.
- C taken: the comment now says the selector reads only the newest completed push/schedule runs on main up to its own cap and that retention is deliberately wider than that window, not a measurement of it. Accurate against `selectRuns` (per_page 50, examined cap limit x 5).
- A taken, judged under the test file: on this head's PR CI the shards again ran the affected speed (every `Test UI (N/16)` log: `Affected speed: 683 vitest filter(s)`), so the ci.yml reporter flag itself was still not executed by a shard, as expected on a pull request; the load is now proven by the smoke instead (below).

**ui-test-timings-refresh.yml**: holds.
- D taken: `Refuse a dispatch on any ref but main` is the FIRST step of the job (line 107), before `Checkout repository` (115), `Setup Node.js` (120), the selector (125), and long before the credential check (262), the token mint (275) and the write (290). Its `if:` reads only `github.event_name` and `github.ref`; the ref reaches the shell through `env: REF`, inside double quotes, as an `::error` annotation text; `exit 1` reds the run with nothing checked out, nothing regenerated and no credential read. On `schedule` and `pull_request` the step is skipped and the lane runs as judged before. A tag or any non-main branch dispatch is refused alike.
- Token scope, secret use, the pull_request dry-run posture, the NOT MEASURED path, the drop-by-name on partial downloads, the opens-a-PR-never-pushes-main write step: all unchanged from 6587756255 and re-read unchanged in this tree. The `Regenerate the per-file test timings` check-run on this head is green on the NOT MEASURED path.

**ui/scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts** (read as the gate of the ci.yml hunk; A's instrument):
- What it does: resolves `vitest`'s bin through `createRequire` from the ui tree, writes a scratch root with an empty `vitest.config.mjs` and one `smoke.test.mjs`, spawns `node VITEST run --root DIR --config DIR/vitest.config.mjs --globals --reporter=default --reporter=ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_test-file-timings.mjs` with `OBJECTUI_TEST_TIMINGS_OUT` set, and asserts exit 0, the schema tag and `files` equal to `['smoke.test.mjs']`. This is the load boundary the first record said nothing on a PR proved: vitest's own CLI resolving a reporter by absolute path, the spelling ci.yml passes.
- Did it run in this head's PR CI: yes. The job log of `Test UI (11/16)` (check-run 125536096129) shows `unit scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts (16 tests) 830ms`, green: the file's fifteen cases plus this one. The other fifteen shards did not carry the file (the always-on set is partitioned across the sixteen legs).
- Can it red or hang a shard: it cannot hang. `spawnSync` carries `timeout: 120_000` (the child is killed and `status` becomes null, which fails the `toBe(0)` assertion with the child's output attached), the case carries its own 180 s vitest timeout, and the shard's `timeout-minutes: 30` stands above both. It reds a shard only when the reporter fails to load or to write under the real CLI, which is precisely the failure the ruling's "never red a Test UI shard on main" guarantee wants caught on the PR that introduces it, in the affected speed, rather than on main's next full battery. Observed cost on CI: under a second for the whole file. The spawn builds its environment with `childVitestEnv()` (the `VITEST*` scrub and the agent-marker scrub), which `spawned-vitest-child-env-8616.test.ts` pins for every vitest spawn in the test tree; that pin is in the same green shard set. The scratch root's empty config means the ui tree's projects, setup files, sequencer and invocation guard are not in the child, so the case measures the reporter load and nothing else.
- Residual, not a finding: a runner so slow that a trivial vitest CLI run exceeds 120 s would red this case; the observed 830 ms for the whole file puts that two orders of magnitude away, and the failure would be a visible red on the PR's affected speed, never a hang and never main's full battery.

Security-relevant observation, stated plainly: unchanged from 6587756255 and strengthened by D. The write path is reachable on `schedule` and on a `workflow_dispatch` from `refs/heads/main` only; any other dispatch ref is refused before checkout; a `pull_request` run never mints or uses the fleet App credential and cannot push, open or label; the credential is narrowed to this repository with contents and pull-requests write only, lives in the write step's env alone and is revoked by the action's post step; no `${{ }}` inside any `run:`; the only external inputs are numeric run ids from the Actions API (branch main, event push/schedule) and artifact contents produced by main's own ci.yml, reaching only the PR body via `--body-file` and the sed-escaped step summary. The new ci.yml `overwrite: true` and the new test add no network act and no credential.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none. The four should-fixes of 6587756255 are taken and hold against the tree; the core-lane half of D is carded separately by the seat.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`ci.yml` 的 Test UI 全量腿加挂逐文件耗时 reporter,并在全量电池事件(push / schedule)上传每片报告;新增每周一的 `ui-test-timings-refresh.yml`,把最新合格运行的报告合并成 `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` 并以 fleet App 开 PR(只在 main 上触发,其他分支的手动触发直接拒绝)。
- 为什么改:ui/ 并入时 reporter 与 refresh 都没搬过来,该数据集自 2026-10-19 冻结,CI 读不到 Test UI 各文件耗时,#25911 试点与 #29469 的四个折叠无法在 CI 复核,分片也按旧数据切。
- 风险与回滚:只报不判(按裁决 6583487846 无阈值、无新红门);上传步 `continue-on-error` 且 `overwrite: true`,缺报告只是 warning;reporter 以绝对路径加载已由 PR 内的冒烟用例实跑证明(Test UI 11/16);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml`(test-ui 的 `Run the ui tests` 与新的上传步)、`.github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml`(第一步拒绝非 main 的手动触发;写入路径的 App token 只限本仓 contents/pull-requests 写)、`ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts`,预期 16 passed。
- 需要你做的:受管面(`.github/workflows/**`,Tier H),请审批:契约复审 PASS 评论 6588359667,`Head-sha: 5f0c784fe69e44879a3fe73e2384e64c4f6a66f4`。批准后席位落地;合并后首个全量电池跑完,可在 Actions 手动触发一次 UI Test Timings Refresh(main)拿到首个刷新 PR。
- 席位意见:同意合并。两轮契约复审(6587756255 → 6588359667)无 must-fix,首轮四条 should-fix 已在 `5f0c784f` 全部采纳。
